name: Nalini
verdict: Italian cycling-apparel brand of MOA Sport Mantovani Vincenzo Srl, founded in 1970 by brothers Claudio and Vincenzo Mantovani. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Family-owned Italian company (Mantovani brothers), no state or fund capital disclosed; kit maker of Team Picnic PostNL. No human-rights finding against MOA Sport/Nalini found.
